cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded the party banner like you. Ready to put up. I brought a cake because you never told me it was cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm folding it away. I didn't tell you because I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Away neatly, then. You let me arrive ready to celebrate; that hurt more than a cancellation message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can accept cancelling. Say you're sorry I had to find out with a cake in my hands.

reason: Replace stock confidence with a mistaken copied practical cue and a confident adaptation; maintain exact secrecy, explanation, concealment-apology, endorsement, or delegated-follow-up pursuit.
